svg.text: 5 · AGENTIC BRAIN — Strands multi-agent on AWS App Runner (BedrockAgentCoreApp)

g.text: outcome traces to a rule row
PriorAuth · PayerRules · StaffUsers · Patients · Appointments · IntakeEvents

svg.text: Doctor card dispatched to the clinic approver on PENDING DOCTOR APPROVAL; staff message the patient the confirmed time on APPROVED → SCHEDULED.
1 · A hospital signs up → dashboard_api creates the staff account (PBKDF2) and Amazon SES emails onboarding details → staff sign in to the console.
2 · After an in-person consult, staff start a follow-up → the patient gets a WhatsApp request for both sides of the insurance card + a symptom voice note.
3 · The reply flows WhatsApp → SNS → webhook_receiver → S3 + DynamoDB Streams → channel_dispatcher → the Strands agent on App Runner.
4 · The agent reads the card (Bedrock vision), transcribes the voice (Transcribe); the deterministic rules engine decides coverage → Amazon SES emails the payer.
5 · Staff move the case to PENDING DOCTOR APPROVAL → the doctor card is sent over RCS/WhatsApp → the doctor approves → staff message the confirmed appointment time.
Every coverage decision traces to a specific rule row — never an LLM guess — and is independently cross-checked before any action is taken.
